summary: R2 hybrid storage migration verified. Full pytest suite green (93 passed + 1 R2 smoke skip; was 92+1 pre-added delete_object test). Preview URL live smoke against attendance clock-in and orders PoD confirmed: bare keys are stored in Mongo and hydrated to /api/uploads/<category>/<key> paths in API responses; files are actually written to disk and reachable via HTTP 200. Legacy /api/uploads/... passthrough test passes. 415 rejection on PoD confirmed. delete_object local cleanup covered by new test.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.py is compact and well-scoped; is_r2_enabled(), make_object_key(), save_image_bytes(), resolve_url(), delete_object() all have clear single responsibilities.
resolve_url() correctly short-circuits legacy /api/uploads/... values (backward compat).
R2 presign failure falls back to /api/uploads/<key> silently — good UX but consider logging.warning at minimum (already log.exception, OK).
delete_object() is best-effort silent — appropriate for cleanup jobs; idempotent behavior verified by new test.
PoD route uses order_id (business id like LND-007), not the uuid `id` field — worth documenting in API spec so frontend clients don't confuse the two (existing behavior unchanged by this PR).
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/seed/staff on preview to ensure staff exist; created 1 attendance record and 1 additional PoD photo on LND-007 during live smoke.
context_for_next_testing_agent: R2 live upload path can only be validated in prod with real R2 credentials (see DEPLOYMENT.md §13). The smoke test in test_storage.py auto-skips locally. All fallback (local disk) behavior is fully green.

live_smoke_results.orders_get_single_and_list: pod_urls hydrated on both GET /api/orders and GET /api/orders/{order_id}
